# ReconfigurableNonlinearPhotonicNetworks

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
Photonic hardware with tunable nonlinearities that supports in-situ learning directly on the physical network. Enables energy-efficient, high-speed neuromorphic computing with on-chip learning, bypassing traditional digital bottlenecks.
